title: Add a weighted decision scorecard (price × Michelin density × amenities)
detail: Right now the ranking sorts by Michelin count then star weight. Let the user set weights (e.g. 40% price, 40% density, 20% amenities) and show the resulting order change.
impact: High — turns a ranking into a decision

title: Replace estimated travel times with measured ones
detail: Batch the hotel→restaurant pairs through a live transit planner (or add an 'open in maps' link per pair) so the 60-minute claim stops being a formula.
impact: High — the whole ranking rests on it
effort: Medium (needs an API key or manual check of ~60 pairs)

title: Finish the restaurant data: hours, closures, price for two
detail: 9 of 12 starred rows have no hours and all 12 lack a verified price. A single pass over each restaurant's own site/PDF would close both gaps.
impact: High — these are the two columns you will use at the table

title: Add the remaining 38 one-star and 33 Bib Gourmand rows
detail: The affordable options matter for a couple eating out 14 times; Bib Gourmand is exactly where value is.

title: Complete the video column
detail: 8 restaurants and 3 activities still have no verified video link; add TikTok/Instagram too, which are stronger for food content in China.

title: Add a map with walking/metro isochrones
detail: A single map showing hotel pins and star pins with a 60-minute ring would explain the ranking faster than the table.
effort: Medium (Leaflet + the coordinates we already have)

title: Add a second city to compare (Suzhou / Hangzhou / Beijing)
detail: The brief allows 1–2 weeks; a 4+3 split may beat 7 nights in one city, and Beijing has its own MICHELIN selection.

title: Price tracking + target-price alerts
detail: Store each snapshot with a date so the site can show 'this room was $1,114 on 25 Nov' and flag movement; add a reminder list.
impact: Medium–High (booking timing is the biggest open question)

title: CNY / holiday overlay on the calendar
detail: Show the 5–13 Feb break, Lantern Festival (20 Feb) and the make-up working days directly on the date picker.

title: Currency toggle (USD / CNY / EUR) with the rate date
detail: Prices are USD snapshots converted by Booking.com; Dutch travellers think in EUR and the restaurants price in CNY.

title: Printable one-page summary for the trip
detail: A print stylesheet view with hotel, dates, reservations, phone numbers and addresses — usable offline in China.

title: Split 'verified' vs 'needs review' into a filter on every table
detail: One click to hide rows with any unverified field, so you never plan around a blank by accident.
